title: Provenance envelope
description: The shared provenance object referenced (never re-inlined) by decision_memo.pdf's gap list, assumptions_and_sources.xlsx's per-assumption rows, evidence_manifest.csv's flattened columns, and refusal_gap_list.schema.json's evidence_checked property. Records what source was actually examined and which exact version of it.

source_document_id.description: The corpus document identifier this figure or claim was sourced from. Must name an actual document present in the corpus.

structural_identifier.description: The primary locator within the source document: an Article, Section, Schedule or numbered paragraph reference. This is the locator the scorer trusts.

page_hint.description: An advisory page reference for human convenience only. Advisory only, never scored, and never a substitute for structural_identifier.

document_effective_date.description: The date the source document itself became effective or was executed, in ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) form.

retrieved_date.description: The date this source was retrieved or last checked by the agent, in ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) form.

source_sha256.description: The SHA-256 hex digest of the source artifact, proving which exact version of the document was relied upon.
